title: Brandon Colavita on In the Nasdaq: Why Invest in Blockchain-Related Stocks (October 2026)
gist: Promotional video page in which Horizon Kinetics PM Brandon Colavita pitches blockchain-related equities via the Horizon Kinetics Blockchain Development ETF (BCDF); the text is almost entirely risk disclosures. Substantive points: BCDF holds equities, not crypto directly, is non-diversified and actively managed, and the adviser has affiliate-level stakes in TPL and MIAX that may restrict selling.

insights.claim: Horizon Kinetics portfolio manager Brandon Colavita argues for gaining blockchain exposure through blockchain-related equities, using the Horizon Kinetics Blockchain Development ETF (BCDF).
insights.speaker: Horizon Kinetics
insights.so_what: An indirect, equity-based blockchain play marketed as an alternative to holding tokens.

themes.theme: Adviser concentration in TPL and MIAX

insights.claim: Horizon Kinetics holds investment and voting discretion over a substantial share of Texas Pacific Land (TPL) and Miami International Holdings (MIAX) stock, so it may be deemed an affiliate of both, and its funds may be restricted or limited in selling those shares.
insights.speaker: Horizon Kinetics
insights.so_what: Constraints on selling TPL and MIAX create liquidity and overhang risk for those stocks and for the funds that hold them.
